name: Shirai Mayu
source:
A new conductor. She can be a little clumsy, but is a bright and positive hard worker. Her work attitude is very serious, and she has a strong spirit of service to passengers. 

[From [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/euphoria/game/soy_rankaku/character.html]Official site[/url]]
